_notes.lanes: rl: many short rollouts, tight limits, latency matters for the trainer; eval: benchmark runs, limits as in eval-framework (60 s per sample)
_notes.max_calls: calls from the tests into the completion per task; HumanEval/32 makes ~100
_notes.max_processes: per task, enforced as RLIMIT_NPROC on the task's own uid
_notes.allow_in_sandbox: rl refuses tasks whose tests must run inside the sandbox (weaker guarantees): they come back as infra_error, no reward, so the trainer drops them instead of learning from a hackable check
